metadata.source: Suspicious Process Execution via RDP Session.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: Suspicious Process Execution via RDP Session
properties.description:
Detects suspicious administrative and post-exploitation tool execution
occurring through Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) sessions using Microsoft
Defender for Endpoint remote session enrichment fields.
The rule identifies multiple suspicious tools executed from the same
remote RDP source device or IP address within a short timeframe. This
behavior may indicate unauthorized remote administration, attacker
post-exploitation activity, compromised administrator credentials,
or human-operated ransomware activity.
The detection leverages the following RDP session enrichment fields:
- IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession
- InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP
- InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionDeviceName
The rule focuses on identifying combinations of suspicious administrative
and native Windows tools executed during RDP sessions.
properties.query:
let SuspiciousProcesses = dynamic([
    "psexec.exe",
    "wmic.exe",
    "rundll32.exe",
    "reg.exe",
    "schtasks.exe",
    "nltest.exe"
]);
let ProcessThreshold = 3;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession == true
| where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP)
| where FileName in~ (SuspiciousProcesses)
| summarize
    DistinctSuspiciousProcesses = dcount(FileName),
    ExecutedProcesses = make_set(FileName, 20),
    TotalExecutions = count(),
    AccountsUsed = make_set(AccountName, 20),
    TargetDevices = make_set(DeviceName, 20)
    by
    InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP,
    InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionDeviceName
| where DistinctSuspiciousProcesses >= ProcessThreshold
| project
    Timestamp = now(),
    InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP,
    InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionDeviceName,
    DistinctSuspiciousProcesses,
    TotalExecutions,
    AccountsUsed,
    ExecutedProcesses,
    TargetDevices
| order by DistinctSuspiciousProcesses desc
